title: 2 Hour Chartered Boat Tour from Deep Cove North Vancouver
blurb: The two hour private tour departs from historic Deep Cove North Vancouver and is a 24 km journey of a picturesque glacial fjord formed in the ice age. Get your cameras ready as we island hop, view historic power station sites, Silver waterfalls, a secret cave, waterfront communities and some of the local wildlife including seals, deer, a variety of birds and every once in awhile we will get a rare whale sighting. The two hour tour of Indian Arm will give you memories for a lifetime.
